sentences.text:
2. This writ petition was instituted in the year 2016, with prayers for directions to the respondent authorities to return the already acquired land measuring 5542 Bighas 1 Katha 2 Lechas, which the petitioners allege was illegally acquired and for a direction to pay adequate compensation as per the M/S Grob Tea Company Ltd vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116846140/
2 Assam Fixation of Ceiling of Land Holdings Act, 1956, with interest up-to-date for land measuring 2152 Bighas 2 Kathas 1 Lecha and also to direct the respondent authorities to act as per the orders of this Court passed on 15.09.2000 in Civil Rule No. 3325 of 1993.
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences._hearing_file: M-S Grob Tea Company Ltd vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 4 December, 2025.json

sentences.text: The respondent authorities through the respondent Nos. 2, 7 and 8 have filed their response to the writ petitioner and from a perusal of the aforesaid response, which have also been referred to by the learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners, it is seen that the respondents have admitted the entitlement of the petitioner to be compensated in accordance with the provisions of the Assam Fixation of Ceiling of Land Holdings Act, 1956, to the extent of 2151 odd and odd Bighas of land.

entities.text: Assam Fixation of Ceiling of Land Holdings Act, 1956
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences._hearing_file: M-S Grob Tea Company Ltd vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 4 December, 2025.json

sentences.text: However, the calculation sheet annexed to the affidavit filed by the respondent No. 7 on 21 st of May, 2025, does not appear to conform to the requirements of forms available in the Rules of 1957.
sentences._hearing_file: M-S Grob Tea Company Ltd vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 4 December, 2025.json

sentences.text: 4. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents has prayed for an accommodation so that he may call for the records from the concerned authorities and satisfy himself regarding the mode and manner in which the calculation sheets have been arrived at and whether the modifications in the same necessary to conform with the provisions of the relevant law.
sentences._hearing_file: M-S Grob Tea Company Ltd vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 4 December, 2025.json

sentences.text:
5. Since this matter is pending from 2016, this Court reluctantly grants time till 20th of January,
2026.
sentences._hearing_file: M-S Grob Tea Company Ltd vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 4 December, 2025.json

sentences.text: 6. Mr R Borpujari, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondents is Page No.# 4/4 requested to ensure that all the relevant information regarding calculation etc. are obtained by the next date fixed, so that an attempt can be made to adjudicate the matter on that day.
sentences._hearing_file: M-S Grob Tea Company Ltd vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 4 December, 2025.json

sentences.text: 7. List accordingly.
